title: Step 65-D customer Wholesale application and application-status experience
description: HIGH-risk Step 65-D. Productionize only the customer-owned Wholesale application and status routes using the typed contracts established in 65-B and the server/session foundation from 65-C. Submit through the existing customer session bridge with server-derived idempotency, authoritative province/city validation and fail-closed recovery. Preserve CustomerProfile.customer_type as wholesale identity authority, backend-owned application transitions, and staff-only review/approve/reject.

dependencies.evidence: PR #333 merged; exact-SHA Canonical CI 37965730057, Phase A 37965730066 and Storefront Quality 37965730091 SUCCESS; terminal Lock release comment 6085869501.

audit_findings: POST /customer/wholesale/applications is typed 201, customer-only and requires Idempotency-Key.
GET /customer/wholesale/application is typed as latest application or null.
CustomerProfileResponse.customer_type is authoritative retail|wholesale identity; application status cannot promote browser state.
Backend active application means submitted|under_review and blocks duplicate submit; rejected is terminal and may be followed by a new retail application.
Province/city UUID pair can reuse the canonical Iran geography 1404 reference already used by Account.

acceptance_criteria.description: Wholesale application/status request and response types are direct aliases of generated OpenAPI; no duplicate frontend status/customer_type authority is invented.

Application loader uses the existing server-only customer-session bridge plus CustomerProfile and latest application. Wholesale customers and active submitted/under_review applications cannot reach a second submit form.

Retail customers with no application, or a rejected latest application, may reach the application form. Business fields are bounded to current backend limits and province/city must match the canonical Iran geography reference.

Submission POST uses a server-derived stable Idempotency-Key, treats 201 as success and redirects to /account/wholesale. 409 active-application conflict recovers to status instead of presenting duplicate success or resubmitting automatically.

Status page presents only server-owned submitted|under_review|approved|rejected application state and safe decision/rejection data. CustomerProfile.customer_type remains authoritative for actual wholesale identity.

Persian RTL forms/status UI provides semantic labels/errors, 44px targets, visible focus and responsive behavior; no guaranteed approval/discount, hardcoded wholesale threshold, browser credential storage, or brown palette is introduced.
Storefront verify includes the Step 65-D verifier without removing inherited Step59-65C/API/auth/state/quality gates.

HIGH-risk closure requires exact-head Canonical CI, Phase A, Storefront Quality, CodeQL/Security, deterministic Review, exact-artifact ACTIVE Lock, exact-artifact Project Owner Human approval, protected merge, exact-SHA postmerge verification and terminal Lock release.

external_gate_evidence.rule: Step 65-D is HIGH risk. Owner Human approval must bind to the frozen exact head/artifact only after technical providers, Security, deterministic Review and ACTIVE Lock pass.
